paragraphs: The XF P300 is the current performance-oriented petrol variant of the X260-generation XF, introduced as part of the Ingenium engine family. It uses the AJ200 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbocharged petrol engine, developed as part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium architecture. The AJ200 is a different unit from the earlier Ford-sourced EcoBoost petrol engines used in the X250 generation, and from the Ingenium diesel units fitted to other X260 variants. The petrol Ingenium is widely regarded as a robust, generally reliable unit. Jaguar XF P300 Engine Compatibility Because the XF has spanned two distinct generations with multiple engine families — Ford-sourced EcoBoost petrol units in the early X250, AJ126 supercharged V6s, and then Ingenium petrol and diesel engines in the X260 — getting the right engine for your specific car matters. How much does a Jaguar XF P300 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Do you rebuild AJ200 XF P300 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ200 rebuild. Do you supply used XF P300 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my XF P300 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an XF P300 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most XF owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XF P300 from 2023 to present. The AJ200 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200 rebuild.
